audience: finance and admin teams that approve expense claims in ExpenseIn

useCases.title: Find expenses waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the expenses that await approval, with their approver. Open one expense to read its details.

useCases.title: Review card transactions for a cardholder
useCases.text: List the card transactions of a date range, filtered by cardholder. Then get the user record of that cardholder.

useCases.title: Check expense categories and tax rates
useCases.text: List the expense categories, with the tax rate each one defaults to. Then list the tax rates on the account.

useCases.title: Create an expense for a user
useCases.text: Create an expense for a user, for example a mileage claim. Each call creates another expense, so do not repeat a call.

useCases.title: Add a note to a supplier invoice
useCases.text: List the supplier invoices and credit notes, then add a text note to one invoice.
